Name: NB-IoT TAU refresh frequency
Description: Máx NB-IoT timer required to refresh manually psm tau timer (minutes)

Name: Power saving detection (PS)
Description: Enable/disable power saving detection algorithm using magnetic field variations

Name: PS single delta limit
Description: Magnetic field single axis delta variation to launch radar reading

Name: PS total delta limit
Description: Magnetic field total delta variation to launch radar reading

Name: PS mean loops
Description: Number of loops to calculate magnetic field mean for ps detection algorithm

Name: PS radar reading timeout
Description: Maximum number of minutes without reading radar sensor

Name: Diagnostic mode
Description: Set the device in diagnostic mode

Name: Report loops
Description: Number of program loops [during last report period]

Name: Report power saving loops
Description: Report of number of power saving detection loops executed [during last report period]

Name: Report sendings
Description: Report of number of accumulated Sendings done by the device [during last report period]

Name: Report reconfigurations
Description: Report of number of accumulated Reconfigs done by the device [during last report period]

Name: Report recalibrations
Description: Report of number of accumulated Recalibrations done by the device [during last report period]

Name: Report sending timer
Description: Report of accumulated Send state time (seconds) [during last report period]

Name: Report sleep timer
Description: Report of accumulated Sleep state time (seconds) [during last report period]

Name: Report run timer
Description: Report of accumulated Run state time (seconds) [during last report period]

Name: Serving cell RSRP
Description: Serving cell Reference signal received power

Name: Serving cell RSRQ
Description: Serving cell Reference signal received quality

Name: Sending timer warning
Description: Warning: sending timer is near timeout. Value: r_snd_mean_tmr (milliseconds)

Name: IDLE timeout
Description: Indicate if idle timeout is enough for the default keep-alive

Name: UE downlink block error
Description: Downlink block error rate in physical channel

Name: UE uplink block error
Description: Uplink block error rate in physical channel

Name: Open error counter
Description: To get stadistics is used a loop with 10 sendings, this value count the number of open errors (time to open set to 50 s)

Name: Report request
Description: Force to send node sync report

Name: Deactivate device
Description: Node deactivation: permanent sleep until 3 resets
